description: This file defines a Java interface `ShoppingCartDao` used for data access operations related to shopping carts in an e-commerce application. It includes method signatures for retrieving shopping cart objects by various identifiers and removing carts.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO functionality with additional methods for accessing shopping cart data by different criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a ShoppingCart by its unique code within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Gets a ShoppingCart by ID without collection objects.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Gets a ShoppingCart by code without collection objects.
